hypothesis: Within existing upward-qualified A/B opportunities, relative temporal ordering between daily amount and returns may contain information not in same-day PVR or simple marginal entry strata. Positive centered lag asymmetry is only a directional research conjecture; neither causal flow nor already validated quality.
formula: At signal close t use 21 common-day returns r_j=log(C_j/C_j-1), j=t-20..t; 21 positive CNY amounts. x_j=r_j-mean21(r); y_j=log(A_j/A_first)-mean21(log(A/A_first)). F=sum_j=1..20 y_j*x_j+1; R=sum_j=1..20 x_j*y_j+1; D=sum(|y_j*x_j+1|+|x_j*y_j+1|). Z=(F-R)/D if D>0 else0 for known constant input. Also report F,R,D,variances, AR1 diagnostic. No fitted coefficients or param scan.
why_centered: Uncentered constant activity produces endpoint-return term rather than volume-order information. Centering fixed before cases; it removes amount-level and average-return information, does not assert hidden investor flows.
limitations: Sign includes positive and negative deviations, not uniquely high-amount-before-up. Positive Z is not market direction. Reverse observation-pair order flips Z; physically reversing log-price path also flips return signs, so Z is invariant. AR response of volume to price can create nonzero Z without informative volume. Normalized ratio can be large at small raw amplitude; D and variances retained, no invented significance threshold.
source: Same original adjusted source+CP1_input CNY amount with 22 consecutive valid prices and21 amounts; same source kind/path/segment, facts and CP input close/segment agreement.
